description: Production containerization, PostgreSQL persistence, and dependency readiness

verification_details.api_container: Dockerfile.api built with Python 3.12-slim, non-root appuser, automatic Alembic migration execution, and production Uvicorn server.
verification_details.web_container: Dockerfile.web multi-stage Node/Vite build with Nginx Alpine static web server and SPA router fallback (/index.html).
verification_details.orchestration: docker-compose.yml coordinates PostgreSQL 16, API service with healthcheck dependency wait, and Web frontend with persistent storage volumes.
verification_details.database_persistence: Verified local PostgreSQL 16 on 127.0.0.1:5432 with Alembic migrations at head.
